verdict.rationale: BVNK documents virtual accounts in USD, EUR and GBP created for your business or your customers, and wallets created against a customer ID and reference. It also offers 'channels', unique repeated-use blockchain addresses that never change, plus a unique blockchain address generated for every payment, so incoming funds map to a specific customer or payment. Ledger reports delivered by webhook support reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing customer attribution fields in pay-in webhook or report payloads, any 'named' account-holder detail on virtual accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
